reason: The hypothesis directly restates the defect-accumulation threshold concept and the sequence of deformation mechanisms (dislocations → twinning → amorphization) from P2, P3, P4, P17, P18, and P19, which already report this exact transition in the equiatomic CrMnFeCoNi HEA under extreme deformation. Applying it to the Co-free FeNiCrMn system is a minor compositional change without new justification, and the proposed experimental matrix and falsification test closely mirror the methods and conclusions of those passages and P8.
